title: Recover a peak with a Gaussian fit
summary: Fit a deterministic peak and report the fit status, fitted location, and fitted width instead of judging the curve by eye.
description: Implement PeakFit fit_peak(TH1D& hist). Fit the supplied peaked histogram with a Gaussian TF1 over x in [2,8], then return the fit status, fitted mean, and positive sigma.
requirements: Use a Gaussian TF1 over the fit range [2,8].
Fit the supplied histogram rather than replacing its contents.
Return the fit status so failure is observable.
Return the fitted Gaussian mean and a positive fitted sigma.

examples.input: deterministic peak centered near 5 with width near 0.8
examples.explanation: The numerical fit result is the evidence; a visually plausible curve is not enough.

hints: For a Gaussian TF1, parameter 1 is the mean and parameter 2 is sigma.
Use quiet/no-draw fit options so the kata remains deterministic and focused on the fit result.
learning_goal: Use a fitted model as a numerical result: check status and interpret location and width from fitted parameters.

curriculum.competency: Fit a deterministic peaked histogram with a simple model and interpret fitted location and width.
curriculum.misconception: A curve that looks close to the histogram is sufficient evidence that the fit succeeded and its parameters are meaningful.
curriculum.observable_success: The learner performs the fit, checks its status, and recovers the deterministic peak mean and width within justified tolerances.
curriculum.acceptance: Fit parameters land in justified deterministic tolerances and feedback refers to model/data behavior rather than syntax.

es.title: Recupera un pico con un ajuste gaussiano
es.summary: Ajusta un pico determinista y reporta el estado, la posición y el ancho ajustados en vez de juzgar la curva a ojo.
es.description: Implementa PeakFit fit_peak(TH1D& hist). Ajusta el histograma con pico usando una TF1 gaussiana en x dentro de [2,8] y devuelve el estado del ajuste, la media ajustada y un sigma positivo.
requirements: Usa una TF1 gaussiana en el rango de ajuste [2,8].
Ajusta el histograma entregado en vez de reemplazar su contenido.
Devuelve el estado del ajuste para que un fallo sea observable.
Devuelve la media gaussiana ajustada y un sigma ajustado positivo.

examples.explanation: El resultado numérico del ajuste es la evidencia; una curva visualmente plausible no basta.

hints: Para una TF1 gaussiana, el parámetro 1 es la media y el parámetro 2 es sigma.
Usa opciones de ajuste silencioso/sin dibujo para mantener el kata enfocado en el resultado.
es.learning_goal: Usar un modelo ajustado como resultado numérico: comprobar el estado e interpretar posición y ancho desde los parámetros.

messages.Fitted mean should recover the peak loca: La media ajustada debe recuperar la posición del pico
messages.Fitted sigma should recover the peak wid: El sigma ajustado debe recuperar el ancho del pico
messages.Fitted sigma must be positive: El sigma ajustado debe ser positivo
